_meta.purpose: Source of truth for the memory-contract/v1 provider-method surface. spec.md's provider-method section is rendered from / checked against this file -- do not restate an invariant's rule text here or in spec.md; point at the spec.md section that owns it (see_also).
sources: memory-contract/v1/INVENTORY.md (section 4: provider method surface; section 5: error/refusal paths)
memory-contract/v1/tests/GENERATOR-DECISION.md (section 4: x-invariant list and spec.md section hand-off)

side_effect_class_definitions.pure read: No persisted-state mutation of any kind, including telemetry counters.
side_effect_class_definitions.append: Writes or increments state (new row, schema/pragma setup, use_count/last_accessed telemetry) without changing any trust-relevant field (confidence, stale, flagged_for_review, superseded_at, contradiction links).
side_effect_class_definitions.trust-mutating: Changes a trust-relevant field: confidence tier, stale flag, flagged_for_review, superseded_at, or a contradiction_of/refines link.
side_effect_class_definitions.consent-gated: The call's real effect is deferred to an explicit human/CLI-only consent step; the MCP-reachable call itself can only produce a pending proposal, never the consented outcome.

kb_constraint_repo_path_validation.confirmed_by: kb_session_prime --top_entries capture, cross-checked against src/tools/kb-export.ts, src/tools/kb-import.ts, src/tools/kb-stats.ts, src/tools/kb-session-prime.ts
kb_constraint_repo_path_validation.finding: The 23-tool surface does NOT share one repo_path anchor/validation path. kb_export and kb_import validate repo_path against the real filesystem and throw E-REPO-PATH-INVALID BEFORE getKbProviders is ever called -- the provider method below is never reached on that path. kb_session_prime and kb_stats pass repo_path through verbatim to the provider with no filesystem check, tolerating a missing anchor. This is recorded per affected method entry below as a per-tool 'repo_path_validation' field (values: 'validated-pre-provider' | 'verbatim-passthrough') rather than flattened into one statement, because the same provider method (e.g. list, capture) is reached by tools on both sides of the split.

_meta.not_in_scope: approveDirective, rejectDirective, addDirective, flaggedPairs (INVENTORY.md section 4.2) are CLI-only and not reachable by any registered MCP tool, so they have no entry here.
_meta.kb_setup_absence_note: kb_setup is intentionally absent from every `tools` array below, and its absence is not a gap. It is a pre-provider configuration tool: it installs the git post-commit hook, writes a single GLOBAL provider config, and stores remote credentials -- it never resolves a project KB and reaches no MemoryProvider member, so there is no P-*/X-* entry it could map to. It is also the one kb_* tool that does not spread kbScopeFields, so its repo_path carries no scope semantics (INVENTORY.md section 2, 'Scope-field note', and section 12 `kb_setup`). It still has a request schema, a response schema, an MCP binding and a fixture, because it is one of the 23 registered tools; only the provider-method mapping is empty, and its binding therefore carries an empty errors[] array.
_meta.httpKbProvider_note: HttpKbProvider is dead code in this tree (INVENTORY.md section 4.4, F-10): every MemoryProvider entry below describes SqliteProvider behavior, which is the only implementation any tool call can reach.
_meta.non_error_outcomes_note: A method's `error_codes` field cites ONLY names taxonomy.json's groups[].codes disposes as real error codes. A method that can also reach one of taxonomy.json's `non_error_outcomes` (a documented success-path adjustment or degradation that deliberately gets no code, with its own reason_no_code there) cites that name in a separate `non_error_outcomes` field instead, never bare inside `error_codes` -- tests/memory-contract-taxonomy.test.ts enforces this split. Affected methods: P-2 capture (E-CLAMP, E-CONTRADICTION-FLAGGED, E-DEDUP-NONE, E-DIRECTIVE-QUARANTINE), P-10 stats (E-STATS-UNSUPPORTED, E-BIBLE-READ-DEGRADED), P-12 relatedClaims (E-RELATED-CLAIMS-DEGRADED), X-2 feedback (E-ROLE-UNKNOWN-DEGRADED), C-1..C-7 (E-CODE-INTEL-DISABLED).

methods.purpose: Set up the provider's storage (schema/pragma) before any other member is called.
methods.tools_note: Not called directly by any registered tool -- invoked during provider resolution before the first tool call reaches it.
methods.error_codes_note: No throw site of its own; its absence is what causes E-PROVIDER-UNINITIALIZED on every other member.

methods.signature: capture(input: KBEntryInput, opts?: CaptureOpts): Promise<{id, audn_decision}>
methods.purpose: Capture a learning/fact/file-summary entry into the KB, routed through the AUDN choke point (dedupe, refine-link, contradiction-flag, or add).
methods.idempotent_note: New row per call unless AUDN dedupes to E-DEDUP-NONE.

methods.purpose: Two-level KB search (L1 FTS5 title+summary, L2 full content for top hits), plus list/id/tag/flagged-pair modes.
methods.idempotent_note: Read result is stable but each call bumps use_count/last_accessed telemetry.

methods.purpose: Report fresh/stale/missing status of the given files against the KB's context-cache.
Mark context-cache entries stale for the given file paths after they change.
Look up entries linked to a given entry (refines / contradiction_of).
methods.tools_note: Not reached by any tool in this surface -- internal link inspection only.

methods.purpose: Prime a session with warm KB context: session_warm status, stale files, top entries, recommended GitNexus calls.

methods.signature: promote(id: string, reason?: string): Promise<{id, confidence_before, confidence_after}>
methods.purpose: Upgrade an entry's confidence one tier (UNVERIFIED -> INFERRED -> CONFIRMED), appending the reason as an evidence note.
methods.idempotent_note: No-op only at the CONFIRMED ceiling; below it every call advances one tier.

methods.purpose: Transfer entries to/from a remote KB.
methods.tools_note: Not reached by any tool in this surface.

methods.purpose: Read-only KB health aggregation: totals by confidence/type, stale/flagged/superseded counts, retrieval hit_rate, promote_ratio, coverage.
Bump use_count/last_accessed telemetry for the given entry ids.
methods.idempotent_note: Existence-tolerant; counter advances on each call.

methods.purpose: Fetch entries joined to the given ids by a refines or contradiction_of edge.
methods.tools_note: Only called from kb_query when expand_related is true.

methods.signature: list(opts: {confidence?, type?, module?, symbol?, tag?, limit?}): Promise<KBEntry[]>
methods.purpose: List KB entries by confidence/type/module/symbol/tag, excluding superseded/stale, without touching FTS ranking or telemetry.
methods.tools_note: kb_stats calls it for bible-drift comparison; kb_export calls it (confidence: 'CONFIRMED') to select entries to export.
methods.error_codes_note: E-REPO-PATH-INVALID only applies on the kb_export route, thrown before this member is reached.

methods.signature: feedback(id: string, reason: string, author): Promise<KBEntry>
methods.purpose: Downvote an entry that proved wrong in practice: sets stale + flagged_for_review, appends a note; never deletes, never touches confidence.
Bounded full-KB bidirectional freshness sweep: re-hash every entry's basis, stale mismatches, revive stale entries whose basis matches again.
methods.tools_note: kb_import runs this after import unless skip_sweep is true.
methods.idempotent_note: Idempotent for a fixed worktree state.

methods.purpose: Resolve a flagged contradiction pair: winner to CONFIRMED with evidence appended, loser superseded and staled.
methods.idempotent_note: A second call on the same pair REFUSES (E-RESOLVE-ALREADY-SUPERSEDED) because the loser is already superseded.

methods.purpose: Mechanical hash-basis prefilter over flagged contradiction pairs: auto-resolves a pair where exactly one side hash-matches the current worktree, leaves the rest for the reconciler agent.
methods.idempotent_note: Writes only via resolveContradiction (X-4); a resolved pair is no longer flagged, so re-running is a no-op on it.

methods.purpose: Synchronous existence check for an entry id, used to skip already-imported entries.
methods.idempotent_note: The only synchronous (non-Promise) member on this surface.

properties.note: Property, not a method -- listed for completeness per INVENTORY.md 4.2 X-7, not counted against the 'every method has an entry' acceptance check. kb_freshness_sweep does NOT read it: it calls providers.project.freshnessSweep() with no argument, and the sweep root defaults inside freshnessSweep() itself from the provider's own stored repoPath.

code_intelligence_methods.purpose: Trace the call graph for a symbol: callers and callees across the codebase.
code_intelligence_methods.idempotent_note: Pure proxy to the active provider (codebase-memory, gitnexus, or none); effect and idempotency truly belong to that provider, not this repo.

code_intelligence_methods.purpose: Find what is affected by changes to a symbol (blast radius).
Search the codebase for symbols, patterns, or concepts using natural language or code patterns.
Get callers, callees, and execution flows for a symbol; enriched with KB context.
code_intelligence_methods.tools_note: Also used internally by kb_session_prime for neighbor-symbol expansion, and merged with KB data by enrichContextWithKb -- so its observed shape is provider-shape-plus-enrichment, not the raw provider payload.

code_intelligence_methods.purpose: Get the architectural map of a repository: module communities with their key symbols and files, ranked by size.
Find process flows (entry -> steps -> exit) matching a name or specific endpoints.
Find the test files and test functions that exercise a symbol (transitive callers, depth 2).
